title.zh: Brazil blocks stablecoins from key cross-border payment rail as $1.1 trillion market faces new limits
title.en: Brazil blocks stablecoins from key cross-border payment rail as $1.1 trillion market faces new limits

current_state.zh: Brazil's central bank will bar stablecoins and other virtual assets from settling aggregated cross-border eFX flows starting Oct. 1, requiring those legs to run through licensed FX transactions or qualifying non-resident real accounts.
current_state.en: Brazil's central bank will bar stablecoins and other virtual assets from settling aggregated cross-border eFX flows starting Oct. 1, requiring those legs to run through licensed FX transactions or qualifying non-resident real accounts.
